#USASoftball

research.facts:
USA WNT — Group Oklahoma Playoff Day
**Sources consulted:** WBSC.org schedule/results page, SI.com WNT Group Oklahoma recap, D1Softball.com Group Oklahoma Day 2 recap, WBSC.org Day 3 blog, AWSN.tv preview
**Key verified facts:**
- TODAY (Sept. 16) is the final day of the WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Group Oklahoma City 2026 at Devon Park, Oklahoma City
- Playoff format: No. 1 vs. No. 2 at 1 PM ET (winner earns direct Redcliffe berth), No. 3 vs. No. 4 at 4 PM ET, Repechage (second direct berth) at 7 PM ET
- USA entered the playoff bracket as the top seed after a dominant 4-0 group stage run including multiple run-rule victories (over Mexico Day 1, Brazil 17-0 Day 2)
- China also among the top seeds; both teams were unbeaten through most of the group stage
- Two direct berths to 2027 WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Finals in Redcliffe, QLD available — also a LA28 Olympic qualifier
- Gasso, JT Gasso and Rocha coaching USA; expected to return to Norman after bracket concludes today
- 4 Sooners on roster: Alyssa Brito, Jayda Coleman, Tiare Jennings, Kelly Maxwell
- Garcia + Mulipola: Tokyo 2020 silver medalists; 7 World Games gold medals among the group
- USA went 5-0 at Devon Park in the 2025 USA Softball International Cup
- SI.com headline: "USA Collects 3 Run-Rule Victories in WBSC Women's Softball World Cup Oklahoma City Group" — verified
